problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package 1: size 58 cubic feet
* Package 2: size 55 cubic feet
* Package 3: size 46 cubic feet
* Package 4: size 31 cubic feet
* Package 5: size 67 cubic feet
* Package 6: size 38 cubic feet
* Package 7: size 54 cubic feet
* Package 8: size 40 cubic feet
* Package 9: size 58 cubic feet
* Package 10: size 66 cubic feet
* Package 11: size 33 cubic feet
* Package 12: size 54 cubic feet
* Package 13: size 35 cubic feet
* Package 14: size 67 cubic feet
* Package 15: size 55 cubic feet
* Package 16: size 51 cubic feet
* Package 17: size 44 cubic feet
* Package 18: size 62 cubic feet
* Package 19: size 59 cubic feet
* Package 20: size 32 cubic feet
* Package 21: size 60 cubic feet

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic feet. Assign all packages using the fewest trucks. Every package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total size of packages in any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
